$comment: The native platforms whose checks are paused until they catch up with the web (CONTRIBUTING.md#native-ci-is-paused). One switch: CI's changes job skips their jobs, release.yml publishes none of them, and the root `pnpm build`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm check` leave their packages out (scripts/run-unpaused.mjs). Take a platform out of the list in the commit that brings it up to the current specs.
